Grenada

Citizenship by Investment

Exclusive citizenship in one of the Caribbean’s most sought-after countries, offering a unique pathway to U.S. business expansion and lifestyle opportunities.

Program
Overview

As a member of the Commonwealth, Grenada launched its Citizenship by Investment (CBI) Programme in 2013. It stands out as the only one among the five Caribbean CBI countries to hold an E-2 Treaty with the United States, enabling its citizens to apply for the U.S. E-2 Investor Visa.

Eligibility Criteria

  1. Main Applicant

    • At least 18 years of age
    • No criminal record
    • Source of funds fulfills investment requirements

  2. Eligibility of Dependents

    • Spouse of the main applicant
    • Unmarried children under 30 years of age (maximum 29 at point of submission)
    • Parents and parents in law above 55 years of age
    • Unmarried sibling over 18 years and below 30 years of age

Key Benefits

  • Secure, lifelong citizenship can be passed on to all future generations; newborn children and a newly married wife can be added for free
  • Minimal taxation
  • Global mobility with visa-free and visa-on-arrival travel to 140+ countries and a unique pathway to acquire US E-2 treaty visa
  • Eligible for reduced tuition fees to world accredited universities

About the Grenada Program

A Closer Look: Strategizing Your Grenada Plan

When clients sit down with us to discuss international mobility and asset protection, they usually have specific destinations in mind. For many high-net-worth families, the ultimate destinations could be the United States, the UK, or the major commercial hubs of Asia. This is precisely where Grenada comes into the picture.

Famed globally as the “Island of Spice”, this lush southeastern Caribbean nation operates a highly sought-after grenada citizenship by investment program. But acquiring a grenada second passport is much more than securing a luxury tropical retreat. It functions as a highly effective bridge connecting your family directly to the world’s biggest economies. Let’s look at the details of this program and why it is such a valuable tool for global investors.

Unlocking Top-Tier Global Access: Your Gateway to the US and Asia

When our clients evaluate a second citizenship program, travel freedom is usually at the top of the list. What makes a grenada passport truly stand out is its unique global travel profile.

It is the only Caribbean citizenship program that holds an E-2 Investor Visa treaty with the United States, while also offering straightforward visa-free access to mainland China. We frequently advise manufacturing executives and global supply chain owners who rely on this exact status to move effortlessly between factories in Shenzhen, boardroom meetings in New York or London, and financial centers across the European Schengen Area, Singapore, and Hong Kong. It eliminates the frustration of unpredictable visa wait times for most major business destinations.

Regarding the US E-2 visa route, our advisory team aims for complete transparency at all times. Under standard US federal regulations, CBI investors must be continuously domiciled in Grenada for three years before applying for the E-2 visa. Instead of seeing this as an obstacle, many of the families we advise view this period not as a delay, but as a highly practical stepping stone. Spending a few years in a tax-friendly Caribbean environment serves as an excellent home base while you finalize your family’s relocation to the US. Once granted, the E-2 visa allows you to operate a business and legally work in the US, providing a fantastic opportunity to expand your global footprint and build a new life there.

A World-Class Foundation for Your Family’s Future

Besides commercial expansion, securing this status is a long-term investment in the next generation. Holding a Commonwealth status provides easier access to prestigious universities across the UK, Europe, and North America, helping your children stand out in competitive academic environments. As Grenadian citizens, your children may also be eligible for reduced tuition fees at various internationally recognized universities.

Furthermore, Grenada is home to St. George’s University (SGU), one of the world’s premier international medical schools. If your children dream of pursuing a medical career in the United States, an SGU education has an outstanding track record of placing graduates into US hospital residency programs.

Beyond the classroom, the island’s rich mix of fascinating cultures makes it an ideal place to raise a family. Growing up in a community that perfectly blends African, French, and British traditions gives your children an unparalleled edge: it naturally fosters a global perspective and strong cultural adaptability, preparing them to thrive anywhere in the world.

The grenada passport by investment program is also incredibly generous when it comes to family inclusion. You can include your spouse, dependent children, parents, parents-in-law, and even unmarried siblings on the same application. Plus, we love pointing out a unique long-term benefit: if your life circumstances change after your citizenship is granted, you can add your newly married spouse and newborn children to your status for free.

Strategic Investment Pathways

How do you structure the investment? Exploring citizenship by investment in grenada generally leads to two distinct investment routes. Our consultants work closely with you to determine the best fit for your goals.

The National Transformation Fund (NTF) is extremely popular for clients who prefer a straightforward and cost-effective approach. You make a single, non-refundable economic contribution that directly supports the island’s national development across sustainable infrastructure, agriculture, and tourism. Investors appreciate this route because it is entirely clear-cut – once the funds clear, you secure your grenada citizenship, and there are no ongoing property upkeep concerns to manage later.

Alternatively, the Real Estate option appeals to those who want to hold hard assets. It allows you to buy a share in government-approved luxury resort developments or purchase a premium villa. Given the island’s booming tourism industry, this route offers the dual benefit of potential rental income and a clear path to resell the property after the mandatory holding period. It is a highly effective way to diversify your portfolio while obtaining your second passport.

Efficient Vetting and Clear Timelines

When planning your family’s global future, having a clear and predictable timeline is a major advantage. One of the biggest reasons we frequently recommend this specific program is how remarkably fast and stable the entire process is. Securing your grenada citizenship by investment typically takes just 6 months from start to finish.

The government conducts rigorous background checks to ensure only individuals with an excellent personal record and clear source of funds are approved. This thorough vetting process is exactly what safeguards the global reputation and long-term value of your family’s grenada passports.

So, what does this timeline look like in practice?

During the first month, our advisory team sits down with you to meticulously organize, translate, and verify all required documents, building a rock-solid application. Once we officially submit your file, the government begins its rigorous due diligence process. This is the standard waiting period, but you do not need to put your life or business on hold. Our processing team monitors the progress and keeps you fully updated.

After you clear all checks, the government issues an official approval letter. You only transfer your major investment funds after receiving this official green light. Shortly after the payment clears, your highly secure passports are delivered safely to your home. With your new passports in hand, you and your family are officially welcomed as citizens in Grenada.
